resources.string: Share your Android screen and speak naturally with Google Gemini Live API using your own API key.

Your Gemini API key is stored on this device and is used to connect directly to Google\'s Gemini API. Because this is a client-side application, a determined attacker with access to the device or application runtime may be able to extract it. Only use an API key you control.
Gemini API usage is billed or rate-limited according to your own Google AI Studio account and selected model eligibility.
Active while ScreenSight AI is sharing your screen or streaming voice with Gemini Live.
